measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hgrunt.mdl, models/barney.mdl, models/islave.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, D, D, B where the asset was B, D, D, B: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
1. B is a plain rectangular box with no limbs, head, or torso, so it has no character shape or proportions to speak of.
2. B is one flat grey stone-like surface with no colour variation, paint, or markings, unlike the coloured uniforms and creatures in A, C, and D.
3. B has no face, hands, or clothes, and it has no pose or stance, so it cannot read as a standing figure.
